title: The Range Optimizer
description: Vary range width, volatility, and position size to see how Uniswap v3 gross fee APY and net APY (after rebalancing gas) trade off — and find the volatility-adaptive optimal LP range.
controls: drag range width slider to see the APY vs. range tradeoff
adjust annualized volatility to shift the optimal range
change position size to see when gas drag dominates
switch fee tiers with the 0.05% / 0.30% / 1.00% buttons
keyboard: tab to sliders, arrow keys to adjust
